blockers.computational_exercise: No additional game/data collection needed; feasible under explicitly retrospective event-time assumptions
blockers.execution_adapter: Required: current shared year guards reject 2023–2025 training and historical wrapper discards pre-sale 2026 observations
blockers.verified_point_in_time_claim: Requires authenticated archived responses or provider first-availability/record-version evidence before cutoff. A new live response cannot establish past availability.

calendar.label_window_rule: start-inclusive, end-exclusive; no 2026 labels generated in Phase 8A
calendar.prediction_context: Retrospective pre-sale reconstruction after the 2026 sale ended; not a prospective forecast
calendar.source_access_limitation: The expired Steamworks event page redirects to documentation home. Indexed official text establishes the explicit start/end clock time, with dates/end corroborated in the live Valve announcement archive. This is not a newly downloaded full Steamworks page.

calendar.utc_conversion_method: Python zoneinfo America/Los_Angeles; both endpoints PDT (UTC-07), not a fixed PST assumption
calendar.verification_scope: Official event-calendar research only; no ITAD or game-pricing requests

execution_steps: Verify all frozen Phase 6C/7A/8A checksums, cohort 2000 uniqueness and untouched old evaluation
Build and freeze the 2000-row 2026 feature artifact with exact source/raw-index receipts and explicit event-time-only status
Validate 15-column names/order/types/nulls; independently prove cutoff removal/exact-boundary invariance
Construct unchanged XGBoost pipeline and fit fresh preprocessing/model once on 6000 frozen 2023–2025 rows only
Save a new refit pipeline/configuration/learned-imputer manifest and verify reload on training probes
Generate one probability/class per game using the frozen 2026 feature artifact, threshold 0.5; do not consult 2026 outcomes
Save predictions with retrospective/backfill/missingness metadata and integrity receipt; report without prospective claims

features_2026.input_histories: Full existing parsed caches; never apply historical wrapper 2026-01-01 truncation
features_2026.missing_values: Preserve nulls in the 2026 feature artifact; transform using only the refitted historical training imputer
features_2026.point_in_time_status: Unverified: all currently available history receipts are post-cutoff
features_2026.timestamp_rule: Strictly timestamp < 2026-10-01T17:00:00Z; exact-boundary and later records excluded

predictions.probability_target: Observed ITAD discount evidence in the verified 2026 Autumn Sale window

preservation.old_evaluation_metrics: Benchmark of the original 2023–2024 model only; not fresh performance estimates for the new 2023–2025 refit
preservation.original_2025_evaluation: Leave all Phase 7 models, selection receipts, predictions and 2025 metrics unchanged; no re-evaluation of the new refit on its training year 2025
preservation.output_namespace: Separate new reports directory for Phase 8B; preserve all Phase 6/7/8A outputs
preservation.raw_caches_cohorts_labels_and_journal: Read-only, checksum-verified; no ITAD calls or new games
preservation.saved_model: Create a separately named 2023–2025 refit pipeline; do not overwrite selected_model.joblib

scope: Retrospective event-time pre-sale predictions of observed ITAD discount evidence; provider point-in-time availability unverified

training.all_missing_training_feature_policy: Preflight must show none; otherwise stop and document a policy before fitting
training.preprocessing: Fresh median imputation fitted only on the 6000 frozen 2023–2025 rows. No 2026 data used to fit transforms, select features or tune. No silent zero filling.
training.prohibited_training_information: Any 2026 target sale outcomes, labels, prices or observations at/after target cutoff; no raw-history relabeling or feature regeneration for old years
training.target_semantics: Observed qualifying Autumn Sale discount evidence; zero does not verify nonparticipation
